item.title: [The Verge] Engram is a sampler that turns broken AI hallucinations into music
item.description: Music startup Thoughtful Things has just launched the Kickstarter campaign for its first instrument, Engram. It's a sampler and groovebox that uses AI to mangle incoming audio and even hallucinate completely new sounds. This isn't Suno in a box, though.
